description:
About Our Brand and Products

Strikely Golf is a UK-based golf training brand founded by two brothers — Harrison (PGA Professional) and Pierce — whose journeys have been defined by a lifelong passion for the game and a commitment to helping every golfer improve.

Our flagship product, the Swing Acceleration Stick, is a 3-stage detachable speed trainer priced at £69 — designed by PGA professionals to help golfers of all levels build real clubhead speed, improve sequencing, and groove a repeatable tempo. It works through progressive overload: a 240g main barrel with 35g and 50g add-on weight stages, so you train faster and safer over time. Every order includes a free printed 6-Week Training Programme in the box — no app, no subscriptions, no extras to buy.

Golfers following the programme are seeing 5–7 mph average swing speed gains and 10–20 yards of extra carry — in sessions as short as 3 minutes.

What Makes Us Different

The golf training aid market is crowded, but most products cost a fortune. Our closest competitors — SuperSpeed Golf and RypStick — retail at £179+ and £139+ respectively. The Swing Acceleration Stick delivers three progressive training stages in a single, compact, detachable stick for £69, with free UK delivery and a free training programme included.

There's no need to buy a separate app, a set of three full-length sticks, or an add-on guide. Everything is in the box from day one. We're a small, founder-led British brand, and that means genuine customer care — reachable directly at hello@strikelygolf.com.

How Affiliates Can Earn

We're offering a 12% commission on every sale you generate — one of the strongest rates available in the golf training aid space.

  • Commission: 12% per sale
  • Product price: £69.00
  • Earnings per sale: ~£8.28
  • Cookie window: 30 days
  • Free UK delivery removes a common objection for your audience
  • 30-day money-back guarantee makes it a low-risk, easy recommend

The £69 price point is a genuine competitive advantage — it's a natural hook in any content piece, review, or comparison, and it converts well because it's less than half the cost of the market leaders while delivering equivalent (or better) results.

How to Promote Us

The Swing Acceleration Stick performs strongly across these channels:

Content and review: Write a "best golf training aids" article, a "does it work?" review, or a distance improvement piece. The price comparison angle writes itself — £69 vs £179+ is a compelling hook.

Video: Demonstrate the 3-stage system in use. Before/after swing speed clips, warm-up routines, and unboxing videos perform particularly well with golf audiences on YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok.

Email: Golf newsletter audiences respond very well to gear recommendations from trusted voices. The launch price and free training programme are strong email hooks.

Social and community: Share in golf Facebook groups, Reddit golf communities (r/golf), and Instagram. Authentic, user-led content converts well in this niche.

SEO: Target keywords like "golf swing speed trainer UK," "best speed training aid," or "how to increase swing speed at home."

We're happy to provide product images, spec sheets, and key messaging — just reach out after joining via the UpPromote platform.

Other Information

  • Price: £69.00
  • What's included: 3-stage Swing Acceleration Stick + free printed 6-Week Training Programme + 6-month warranty
  • Shipping: Free UK mainland delivery. Outside UK mainland £15 | Europe £25 | USA £30
  • Returns: 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked
  • Warranty: 6 months
  • Contact: harrison@strikelygolf.com
  • Based in: Epping, Essex, UK
